text:
Alex: Quick question — when a saved query is pinned to a route, should the console show a routing/quota nudge inline? Customers are confused about which model/slot is used and why sample rates change.
Maya: yes, surface a lightweight hint, collapsed by default. After pin: "Pinned to /checkout (uses model-x, sample 10%)".
TJ: are these telemetry-only hints or actionable? If actionable, we must include the effective routing policy in the savedview payload.
Alex: Actionable. At minimum show computed routing policy + quota impact so folks know before running expensive compares.
Sarah: UX: show model name, sampling %, and a tiny link to fallback docs. A small inline pill with a ? tooltip should work.
Maya: API plan: add an optional nullable string field on savedview response called routing_estimate_text and a confidence flag string. Keeps contract backward compatible.
TJ: We should avoid leaking internal region/fleet identifiers. routing_estimate_text should be human-friendly, e.g. 'Model: Llama-2-13b-quant, Sample: 10% (estimate)'.
Sarah: Also add a confidence marker when the estimator is uncertain (autoscale/commit changes).
Alex: How expensive to compute? Can't have list calls block requests.
Maya: Cheap — same fast evaluator runtime uses. We'll cache per-savedview for 5m and do async recompute on rollouts.
TJ: Impl note: do not call the full placement engine in request path. Use the fast routing evaluator and return estimated=true when unsure.
console-bot: deploy-check: api/savedviews schema change planned; feature flag preview-routing-pill will gate the UX during early rollouts.
Sarah: Rollout: cohort A gets the pill, cohort B doesn't. Track pill impressions, clicks, and whether they then run a compare.
Alex: Yep — objective: reduce surprise incidents and increase informed compares.
Maya: I'll open a small PR to add routing_estimate_text and confidence flag. PR by EOD.
TJ: I'll add server-side caching and fallthrough behavior to return an 'estimated' confidence when uncertain.
Alex: Wording: UX wants the term 'Estimate' instead of 'Preview' in the pill.
Sarah: Fine with 'Estimate'. Tooltip text will explain autoscaling/reserved capacity caveats. :thumbsup:
Alex: Filed a short design note and linked it from the PR.
Maya: Will tag the rollout ticket when PR is up.
TJ: Infra will watch for extra evaluator calls during rollout.
console-bot: PR opened by @maya: https://git.internal/r/redwood/savedviews/+/2345, feature flag preview-routing-pill set to off in prod.
